mapper.insert: INSERT INTO follows (follower_id, following_id, created_at) VALUES (#{followerId}, #{followingId}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM follows WHERE follower_id = #{followerId} AND following_id = #{followingId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM follows WHERE following_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM follows WHERE follower_id = #{userId}

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.user_name AS userName, u.profile_image AS profileImage, -- 뷰어(viewerId)가 이 유저(u.user_id)를 팔로우 중인지 확인 (맞팔 체크) CASE WHEN f2_id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS isFollowing FROM follows f JOIN users u ON f.follower_id = u.user_id -- viewerId가 null이 아닐 때만 LEFT JOIN 수행 LEFT JOIN follows f2 ON f2.follower_id = #{viewerId} AND f2.following_id = u.user_id WHERE f.following_id = #{targetId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.user_name AS userName, u.profile_image AS profileImage, CASE WHEN f2_id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS isFollowing FROM follows f JOIN users u ON f.follower_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN follows f2 ON f2.follower_id = #{viewerId} AND f2.following_id = u.user_id WHERE f.follower_id = #{targetId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
